body:
I saved the cloth with milky water for you. The crop plot crew passed Saturday near lunch; two hens went still, and afterward the lane was closed.

We needed the supplies listed here for the following morning. The people who took the count left without asking whether we had them.

Someone had to finish the household list even though the office had closed. I wrote the names in the space left for expenses.
title: Saturday near lunch — milky water
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same milky water while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
